response.note: Counts failed attempts per South-region merchant for last calendar week (Mon 2026-10-19 to Sun 2026-10-25); the status value 'FAILED' and region value 'South' are assumed spellings.
response.sql: SELECT merchant_id, merchant_name, COUNT(*) AS failed_attempts FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-19' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-26' AND region = 'South' AND status = 'FAILED' GROUP BY merchant_id, merchant_name ORDER BY failed_attempts DESC LIMIT 50
